name: Tempester n°32: a footswitch plays a pad (Pedal 1/2 Assignment « Pad 1 » to « Pad 16 » in switch modes)
explanation: Why: a footswitch could start/stop, record, roll, reverse, change beat or reset Beat FX, but not play a pad (forum request 702#21). The System setting « Pedal n Assignment » in a switch mode (Switch, Norm Open / Norm Closed; byte [address] + 3 * input, 0-10) now goes on to 11-26 = « Pad 1 » ... « Pad 16 »: the footswitch is that pad of the panel. Press = panel message 0x50 + pad ([routine], velocity = Fixed Level Velocity [address] + 1), release = message 0x60 + pad ([routine]), only when the pad is down (byte [address] + pad * 0x14), so the machine does what that pad does in the current Pad Function. Hooks: [routine] (switch input, main loop step 9, outside any UI dispatch) ends with « j [routine] » (event signal 9): replaced by « j SW », which publishes as before for 0-10 and calls the pad functions for 11-26 (press = state 0 for Norm Open, 0x7F for Norm Closed, as case 9 of [routine]); the editor's limit words [address] / [address] (low half 10 -> 26; read only by [routine] at [address] / [address]); the label: cases 0x52 / 0x55 of [routine] (jump table words [address] / [address], were [address]) go to LABEL, which keeps the original case for 0-10 and appends « Pad » and the number for 11-26. The setting is saved and loaded as a byte without range check (unchanged). Controller mode unchanged. No RAM. Code 0x9d07cd50-0x9d07cdff, free flash.

edits.why: j 0x9d07cd50 ; [routine]: was "j [address]" (switch event, signal 9), made by SW for functions 0-10; delay slot "sb a2,0x1(v1)" kept
.word 0x9d07cdb8 ; [routine] jump table, case 0x52 (Pedal 1 Assignment, switch mode): was [address]
.word 0x0000001a ; Pedal 1 Assignment, switch mode: largest value 10 -> 26 (low half; high half 0 unchanged)
.word 0x0000001a ; Pedal 2 Assignment, switch mode: largest value 10 -> 26
sll t0,a0,0x1 ; Live: a0 = input 0-1, a1 = new state (0 or 0x7F), ra = main loop; main loop only
beq t4,zero,[address] ; functions 0-10: event signal 9 as before ([routine] with a0, a1 unchanged)
lbu t2,0x4a2d(t0) ; delay slot: mode [address] + 3 * input (1 Norm Open, 2 Norm Closed: only these call [routine])
bne t5,t2,0x9d07cd8c ; pressed when state 0x7F for Norm Closed, 0 for Norm Open: as case 9 (> 0x40 / < 0x41)
or a0,t3,zero ; delay slot: a0 = pad 0-15
lbu a1,0x4a3d(gp) ; [address] Fixed Level Velocity (0-126, shown + 1)
j [address] ; pad press, as panel message 0x50 + pad (event signal 7 subtype 1)
addiu a1,a1,0x1 ; delay slot: velocity 1-127, the one Fixed Level gives
lbu t7,-0x8b4(t6) ; pad down flag [address] + pad * 0x14 (set by the press, cleared by the release)
beq t7,zero,0x9d07cdb0 ; pad not down: nothing
j [address] ; pad release, as panel message 0x60 + pad (event signal 7 subtype 2)
sll t5,s1,0x1 ; Live ([routine] after its jr): s1 = input 0-1, frame with s0-s2 and ra saved
addiu s0,t1,-0xa ; pad number 1-16 (s0 is restored by [routine]'s epilogue)
j [address] ; append(buffer, decimal(pad number)), then the function's return of the buffer
